faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the Research Associate position at IIT Roorkee?
faq.answer: The last date to submit your application for the Research Associate position at IIT Roorkee is 25th August 2026. Ensure your application reaches the designated email address before this deadline.

faq.question: Q2. What is the educational qualification required for the Research Associate role?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a PhD in Civil Engineering from a reputed institution like IITs, IISc, NITs, or CSIR laboratories. Expertise in specific areas may be preferred.

faq.question: Q3. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this Research Associate recruitment at IIT Roorkee.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary offered for the Research Associate position?
faq.answer: The selected candidate will receive a monthly salary of Rs. 61,000 plus HRA.

faq.question: Q5. How can I apply for the Research Associate position?
faq.answer: Applications are to be submitted via email. You need to send your complete bio-data and required documents to the official email address provided in the notification.

faq.question: Q6. What is the advertisement number for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The advertisement number for this Research Associate recruitment is SRIC/06.

faq.question: Q7. What is the total number of vacancies for the Research Associate post?
faq.answer: There is one vacancy for the Research Associate position announced by IIT Roorkee.

faq.question: Q8. What is the selection process for this role?
faq.answer: The selection process for the Research Associate position will primarily involve an interview.

faq.question: Q9. Does IIT Roorkee offer any age relaxation for reserved categories?
faq.answer: The official notification does not specify age relaxation details. Candidates are advised to refer to the official notification for any such information.
